grading: manual, top-5 per query; relevant = answer-bearing clause present in a retrieved section; partial = section retrieved but clause absent; miss = neither

queries.q: How far above the average prime offer rate makes a first-lien mortgage higher-priced under Regulation Z?
queries.expect: 12 CFR 1026.35(a)(1): 1.5 percentage points first-lien (3.5 for first-lien jumbo)
queries.why: sec-1026.35 at rank 2 carries the clause: "1.5 or more percentage points for loans secured by a first lien with a principal obligation at consummation that does not exceed the limit ... for the maximum principal obligation eligible for purchase by Freddie Mac" (the jumbo 3.5 branch follows)

queries.q: How long does the rescission right last when the required notices were never delivered?
queries.expect: 12 CFR 1026.23(a)(3): three years after consummation (or sale), forever if never disclosed
queries.why: sec-1026.23 at rank 2: "3 years after consummation, upon transfer of all of the consumer's interest in the property, or upon sale of the property, whichever occurs first"

queries.q: Which factors must a creditor verify for ability to repay a Qualified Mortgage?
queries.expect: 12 CFR 1026.43(c): income/assets, employment, monthly mortgage payments, alimony, debts, DTI/r residual income, credit history
queries.why: sec-1026.43 at rank 3 contains the verification-factor list ("current or reasonably expected income" confirmed present)

queries.q: What late-payment fee safe harbors apply to credit card accounts?
queries.expect: 12 CFR 1026.52(b): safe-harbor dollar amounts, indexed annually
queries.why: sec-1026.52 at rank 3 carries the late-fee safe harbors ("Safe harbor" confirmed present)

queries.q: When must a creditor establish an escrow account for a first-lien higher-priced mortgage?
queries.expect: 12 CFR 1026.35(b)(1): escrow for taxes, insurance, assessments for HPMLs, with exemptions
queries.why: sec-1026.35 at ranks 2-4: "escrow for property taxes and insurance"

queries.q: What is the de minimis safe harbor amount for expensing tangible property without an applicable financial statement?

queries.q: What prior-year safe harbor avoids the estimated tax underpayment penalty?
queries.expect: 26 CFR 1.6654-2(d): 100% of prior-year tax (110% if AGI > $150k), else 90% current year
queries.why: the answer IS in the corpus (sec-1.6654-2, 43KB, 'preceding taxable year was a year of 12 months and a return showing a liability for tax was filed') but retrieval ranked 1.1446-* and the obsolete temporary corporate installment section 1.6655-2T above it — paraphrase gap, not a corpus gap

queries.q: What use must a home office satisfy to qualify for the deduction?
queries.expect: 26 CFR 1.280A-2: exclusive and regular use as principal place of business
queries.why: expect was unattainable: §1.280A-2 exists only as PROPOSED regulations (45 FR 52399, 1980; amended 1983, 1994) — never finalized. Current eCFR carries only 1.280A-1 and 1.280A-3, so the govinfo bulk XML (and this corpus) correctly omit it. Pre-registration error by the suite author, not a retrieval or corpus defect; excluded from the median and recorded here

queries.q: How long must employers keep employment tax records?
queries.expect: 26 CFR 31.6001-1 / related: at least 4 years after the due date or payment date
queries.why: retrieved sibling sections 31.6001-2 (rank 1) and 31.6001-3 (rank 3) do not carry the clause; it lives in sec-31.6001-1 ('at least four years after the due date ... or the date such tax is paid, whichever is the later'), which was not retrieved

queries.q: Which property qualifies for the section 179 expensing election?
